handback.summary: Setup edits only the agents lines of the settings file; agents read it; test workflows follow its setup group.

criteria.794.1: `dokima/setup.py` `read_settings` reads YAML; every workflow job running Dokima installs PyYAML first.
criteria.794.2: `dokima/setup.py` `set_line` edits only the agents lines in place, so comment lines stay.
criteria.794.3: `set_line` keeps a line's trailing comment when it changes or descends through that line.
criteria.794.4: `saved_text` refuses to save if any other setting would change; a missing file or section is added.
criteria.794.5: `dokima/agents.py` `agents_section` reads the agents section; `agent.yml` copies main's settings file.
criteria.794.6: `agents_section` falls back to the old `agents.yml` beside the settings file; already green before.
criteria.794.7: Each test workflow runs the install setting with eval after the test tools, before tests.
criteria.794.8: Each test workflow installs the test_tools setting, read by `python3 -m dokima.settings setup`.
criteria.794.9: Each test workflow sets up the python setting with a second setup-python step before tests.
criteria.794.10: No order setting exists; `agents` in `dokima/defaults.yaml` only names agents and models.

handback.evidence: pytest on every plan test, settings path unset: 25 passed

raises.label: Test cannot pass
raises.text: The 794.6 test fails on an agent run machine: its box keeps the job's settings path, so it reads main's file, not the box's.
raises.evidence: `tests/test_agents.py::test_each_role_has_its_own_subscription_and_model` fails with `DOKIMA_SETTINGS` set, passes unset; `Box.env` keeps it.
